column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - the admitted retail .text partition: one row per
# function START (rva) plus its structural kind. No sizes and no names:
# a row's extent is DERIVED to the next row's rva (the last row ends at
# .text's virtual end), so it spans the function's whole contribution,
# trailing jump tables included. The exact CODE size of a byte-matched
# body lives on its claim - RVA(rva, size) in src/. kind: (empty) body |
# thunk (IAT glue) | eh (/GX funclet) | helper (compiler jmp forwarder) |
# pad (non-code fill). Initially admitted from the investigation's Ghidra
# 12.1.2 census (plus LIBC.LIB bodies Ghidra merged); boundary corrections
# are edited here. The build never regenerates this file.
